Configuring the Widget Engine

The widget engine reads its settings from a single file named widget.toml at the project root. Most projects only need to set two or three keys.

Installation

Install the engine with your package manager, then verify the binary is on your PATH. See the release notes for platform specifics.

widgetctl install --channel stable
widgetctl verify

Configuration

Settings are grouped by section. The core section is required; everything else is optional.

KeyTypeDefault
core.modestringauto
core.threadsinteger4
log.levelstringinfo

Advanced options

Advanced options should be changed with care:

  • Pin the engine version in CI
    • Use the --locked flag
    • Commit the lockfile
  • Enable verbose logging only while debugging

Changing core.mode at runtime requires a full restart of the engine.

Questions? File an issue on the tracker.
